title: Re-flow ozw's acceptance criteria so [A1]..[A5] parse as five items
body:
The epic's definition of done states its five [A<n>] marks on one line, and internal/acceptance's parser takes a bracketed [A<n>] only at a line's start (a mid-line bracket is a reference, never a definition), so the record carries exactly one item of record — A1 — and [A2]..[A5] are references nothing can key on: no command can bind evidence to them and a finding cannot name the item it breaks. This epic paid for it twice — its round-1 review's blocking finding (the committed screenshots, [A3]/[A5] material) carried no breaks claim, so the run's absorption had to fall back on the reviewer basis rather than a done-item claim — and it is the same defect the ymf review filed low, recurring one day after ymf's own record was re-flowed. Tick 1ip, open, records it. The tracker edit this finding carries re-marks the same five items one per line — the same words, nothing dropped — so the machinery the epic's close-out feeds (the epic PR's done-evidence section, the [evidence.acceptance] table, a future finding's breaks claim) can address all five.
evidence: .tick/issues/ozw.json acceptance_criteria (one line, [A1]..[A5]); internal/acceptance/acceptance.go:18 (attemptedMark is line-anchored)
